transcript: Last night, my sister and I went to a theatrical wine tasting at Soho Playhouse. This is a part of their international Fringe Encore Series, and it's called In Pour Taste: A Comedy Wine Tasting Experience. I didn't really know what this was gonna be, but it's basically a wine tasting interspersed with some banter and a lot of crowd work by our hosts Ethan and Sweeney. It’s definitely more of a comedy show than like a scripted theater piece, but it had structure and some bits that they most likely do variations of every time. We really enjoyed trying all the wines and learning about them from resident sommelier Olivia White. There's some audience participation which makes for a lot of the humor, especially the further along you get through the wines. Tickets for the rest of this run seem scarce, but rumor has it they may add a performance or two this weekend, if you're looking for something that's a little different and experiential.
